item.title: Preview | Charlton Athletic v Millwall Under 21s
item.description: Millwall Under 21s travel to Sparrows Lane to take on Charlton Athletic in the Professional Development League on Friday afternoon (kick-off 1.30pm). The Young Lions go into this match with two wins, a draw and two defeats from the last five. This has seen Kevin Nugent’s side pick up seven points in the Professional Development League with an away win over Brentford and a home win over Bristol City (both 2-1) and a point in South Wales at Swansea City. item.title: Fly On The Wall | Lions react in SE16
item.description: A BIG win in SE16. Femi Azeez, Tristan Crama and Jake Cooper hit the target as The Lions defeated Birmingham City 3-0 in the Sky Bet Championship at The Den. Go behind-the-scenes on Wednesday's victory in the latest episode of 'Fly On The Wall' below!

item.title: Quartet inducted into Forever Lions Club
item.description: Four more former Millwall players have been inducted into the Forever Lions Club. During the half-time break of The Lions' 3-0 Sky Bet Championship win over Birmingham City on Wednesday night, Teddy Sheringham, Alan Dunne, Tony Craig and Pauline Cope joined those already inducted as they received a standing ovation from those in attendance. More inductees to the Forever Lions Club will be announced soon - keep an eye on millwallfc.co.uk for more details!MORE ON THE FOREVER LIONS CLUB

item.title: Charlie Curtis completes every seat challenge
item.description: Young Millwall fan Charlie Curtis met Luke Cundle and Ryan Leonard on Wednesday night after completing his challenge to sit in every single seat at The Den. Charlie, 14, gave up 17 hours of his time to undertake the mammoth task, completing it to fundraise for two worthy causes: The Lions Food Hub and Cancer Research UK. item.title: Stay connected with your Millwall Profile!
item.description: CREATE YOUR MILLWALL PROFILEHave you created your Millwall Profile yet? It is now easier than ever to stay connected by creating your very own Millwall Profile. You will be able to access your ticketing account, The Lions Store and Millwall TV all via a singular email address and password. However, there are still many supporters - season ticket holders - who have yet to create their profile. If you haven’t signed up, then please do so to make your Millwall experience run as smoothly as possible

item.title: Millwall Lionesses to host Sutton United at The Den
item.description: Millwall Lionesses host Sutton United on Sunday 29th March (kick-off 1.30pm) at The Den - and tickets are now on sale. The Lionesses are looking for your support as they aim for an attendance of 1,000+ in SE16! Tickets will be start to be sold in Block 41 - in the Dockers Stand - with more blocks opening as tickets are sold.
